title: Veterans Pension Medicaid Nursing Home Limit by Rate Category
content:
# Medicaid nursing-home limit — Veterans Pension

The monthly Veterans Pension payable to a veteran without dependents residing in a Medicaid-covered nursing home is limited to USD 90 per month. Whether that limit can apply depends on the rate category:

| Rate category | Medicaid nursing-home limit applies to the category |
|---|---|
| Veterans Pension (Basic Rate, No Dependents) | Yes |
| Veterans Pension (Basic Rate, One Dependent) | No |
| Veterans Pension (Housebound, No Dependents) | Yes |
| Veterans Pension (Housebound, One Dependent) | No |
| Veterans Pension (Aid and Attendance, No Dependents) | Yes |
| Veterans Pension (Aid and Attendance, One Dependent) | No |

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Monthly limit | USD 90 |
| Full calendar months after the month of admission after which the limit applies | 0 |

The limit belongs only to the no-dependent categories, because it applies only to a veteran without a spouse or child.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

With 0 full months to wait, a veteran in a no-dependent category admitted during May reaches the limit starting with June, the first month after the month of admission. A veteran in a one-dependent category admitted the same month is not limited.
